enrollment_lifecycle_records_reason.name: enrollment_lifecycle_records_reason
enrollment_lifecycle_records_reason.value: ("enrollment_lifecycle_records"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("enrollment_lifecycle_records"."reason")) > 0 AND length("enrollment_lifecycle_records"."reason") <= 500) OR ("enrollment_lifecycle_records"."reason" IS NULL AND "enrollment_lifecycle_records"."action" = 'deactivate' AND "enrollment_lifecycle_records"."actor_account_id" = "enrollment_lifecycle_records"."learner_account_id")

override_records_action.name: override_records_action
override_records_action.value: ("override_records"."action" = 'grant' AND "override_records"."grant_record_id" IS NULL) OR ("override_records"."action" = 'revoke' AND "override_records"."grant_record_id" IS NOT NULL)

submission_reviews_revocation.name: submission_reviews_revocation
submission_reviews_revocation.value: ("submission_reviews"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "submission_reviews"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("submission_reviews"."decision" = 'approval' AND "submission_reviews"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_reviews"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("submission_reviews"."revocation_reason")) > 0)
